rule: Watch idle window and remediation-cycle floor
description: P3 coupling. The watch budget is an IDLE window re-armed per completed remediation cycle, not an absolute total budget, and the cycle cap has a floor no caller may undercut. The source pin sits on ONE span carrying BOTH halves of the idle rule: the positive half (a completed remediation cycle re-arms a fresh full window) and the terminating half (a window that elapses with no actionable arrival ends the watch). Pinning only one half leaves the other rewritable -- dropping the re-arm silently reverts `max_watch_duration` to a total budget that expires mid-review, and dropping the elapse clause removes the only stated exit -- so both live inside the pinned span. The consumer pin is deliberately claim-carrying rather than pointer-only: the number 6 IS the contract at the caller boundary, so `plugin/agents/overlord.md` must keep stating the floor verbatim, and lowering or deleting it there turns the suite red. What this fixture honestly guarantees is exactly that these two word sequences exist in these two named files; it claims nothing about meaning and nothing about runtime behavior. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a static pin CANNOT prove the re-arm actually happens at runtime -- it proves only that the contract text is present, and an implementation that arms Monitor once with a total deadline stays green; (2) the sentence that follows the pinned span in the skill (the poll script's deadline being per-process) is deliberately OUTSIDE the pin so it stays rewritable, and deleting it alone stays green; (3) the default-value table row carrying `3600` is unpinned, so a changed default is invisible; (4) the skill's own restatement of the 6-cycle floor is unpinned, so only the overlord-side statement is protected; (5) the pin sees only the two files it names, and no fixture in this directory can detect a NEW caller that invokes the loop without honoring the floor -- that is an absence defect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract and needs a structural check, not a presence pin.

source.pattern: `max_watch_duration` is an IDLE window, not a total budget: a completed remediation cycle re-arms a fresh full window, and a window that elapses with no actionable arrival ends the watch.

consumers.pattern: `max_remediation_cycles` is a FLOOR of 6: no caller may invoke this loop with a lower value.
